text: Grades are awarded on a 10-point scale. A grade of O carries 10 points, A+ carries 9 points and A carries 8 points. The minimum passing grade is P (4 points).
Students must maintain a minimum attendance of 75 percent in every subject to be eligible to appear in the end semester examination.
Students whose attendance is between 65 and 75 percent may apply for condonation. Condonation requires a valid medical certificate and payment of a condonation fee of Rs. 500 per subject.
Students with attendance below 65 percent in a subject are detained in that subject and must repeat the course in the next offering.

Each course is assessed by continuous internal assessment (40 percent) and the end semester examination (60 percent). A student must score at least 40 percent in the end semester examination to pass a course.
A student who misses an end semester examination for a documented medical reason may apply for a supplementary examination within 7 days of the missed paper.

A student may apply for re-evaluation of an end semester answer script within 5 working days of the result announcement. The re-evaluation fee is Rs. 1,000 per paper. The result of re-evaluation is final.
Use of unfair means in examinations leads to disciplinary action as decided by the Examination Malpractice Committee.
